scripts.test:patient-detail-parser: rm -rf test-results/parser-contract && tsc lib/api/clinic-patient-detail.ts --outDir test-results/parser-contract --module commonjs --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && PATIENT_DETAIL_PARSER_MODULE=$PWD/test-results/parser-contract/clinic-patient-detail.js node --test tests/contract/clinic-patient-detail-parser.test.cjs
scripts.e2e: rm -rf test-results playwright-report allure-results allure-report && next build && playwright test
scripts.e2e:local-stack: rm -rf test-results/local-stack && next build && playwright test -c playwright.local-stack.config.ts
scripts.e2e:report: npm run e2e && npm run allure:generate
